fields.statement: At d5dedb22: go test ./internal/changeset -run TestLineDiff passes (middle changed, same, line added, line removed, single to multi cases). go test ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/change-diff passes, including the new step that sets a three-line statement one/two/three to one/TWO/three and checks the '  statement:' header, '      one', '    - two', '    + TWO', '      three' lines. Because the txtar regexes only check that each line is present, I also reproduced it by hand with a scratch build in a fresh repo: change diff printed exactly one - line (two), one + line (TWO) and the two unchanged lines (one, three) around them, nothing else for the field. Read the diff: LineDiff in internal/changeset/linediff.go is an LCS that puts removed runs before added runs, and ChangeDiffResponse.Human uses it only when the old or new value contains a newline, so single-line fields keep the 'a -> b' form. gofmt -l is clean, go vet ./... is clean and go test ./... -count=1 passes.
